title: Research Commons RC-0.1
purpose: A static public-observatory profile for separating knowledge, research cases, work, money, evidence, and relationship before any proposed scientific research market could be considered for operation.

architecture.summary: Three responsibility planes remain separate. Exact static compatibility is reciprocally cross-pinned; the fourth one-way witness seam stays closed pending a successor profile, separate authorization, independent review, and reviewed deployment verification.

planes.label: Knowledge plane
planes.holds: Versioned Tree references and an optional inactive current-only ToK reference shape, plus typed claims, challenges, disprovals, and provenance.
planes.refuses: Money does not set fact status, truth, confidence, graph prominence, qualification, or authority.

planes.label: Research-case plane
planes.holds: Frozen scope, falsifiers, standards, roles, conflict disclosures, evidence gates, budgets, refund rules, and receipt-consumption rules.
planes.refuses: This profile opens no case, accepts no evidence, assigns no reviewer, and adjudicates no result.

planes.label: Work and economy plane
planes.holds: Prospective agent capability offers, bounded work packages, compute or tool expenses, escrow compartments, settlement receipts, and exact inert interchange schemas.
planes.refuses: No AgentTool deployment, account, wallet, escrow, payout, state, or receipt is imported or treated as live; a static format cross-pin transfers no authority.

planes.label: Witness seam
planes.holds: A future one-way, version-pinned projection of already settled public-safe receipts.
planes.refuses: No receipt crosses this seam; a witness would prove neither scientific truth nor payment authority and could not carry confidential bytes.

agent_model.non_completion_disposition: Release only unearned reservations under the frozen case rule; create no person score, reputation loss, debt, or clawback of earned compensation.

ledgers.label: Validity
ledgers.holds: Claim status, typed support or contradiction, challenge, disproof, uncertainty, and supersession.
ledgers.cannot_determine: Novelty, significance, attribution, payment, liability, governance, person worth, consent, identity, or authority.

ledgers.label: Novelty and priority
ledgers.holds: Case-scoped prior-art and caller-declared timestamp references only, plus declared overlap with earlier deliverables; no trusted time, novelty, priority, or precedence adjudication.
ledgers.cannot_determine: Validity, significance, attribution share, payout, liability, governance, rank, or truth.

ledgers.label: Significance and consequence
ledgers.holds: Bounded adoption, downstream consequence, maintenance, and separately evidenced impact claims.
ledgers.cannot_determine: Validity, novelty, contributor ownership, payout, governance, person value, or popularity authority.

ledgers.label: Attribution and credit
ledgers.holds: Artifact-scoped contributor roles, provenance, declared overlap, and bounded lineage credit.
ledgers.cannot_determine: Validity, ownership of a person, transferable reputation, payment, debt, qualification, vote, or rank.

ledgers.label: Funding and liability
ledgers.holds: Prefunded case compartments, earned releases, fixed compensation, fees, reserves, refunds, and bounded liabilities.
ledgers.cannot_determine: Validity, novelty, significance, attribution, reviewer verdict, governance, KARMA, or person score.

ledgers.label: Governance and authority
ledgers.holds: Explicitly authorized offices, scopes, recusals, quorums, appeals, and revocations if a successor system separately creates them.
ledgers.cannot_determine: Scientific truth, novelty, significance, attribution, wealth-based voice, sponsor veto, identity, consent, or personhood.

non_ledger_registers.holds: Bounded deliverables, deadlines, stop paths, completion, decline, pause, rest, and exit state.
non_ledger_registers.cannot_convert_into: Debt, negative reputation, earned-pay loss, validity, funding priority, or authority.

non_ledger_registers.holds: Queries, citations, reuse, maintenance demand, and separately labelled protocol-energy observations.
non_ledger_registers.cannot_convert_into: Money, scientific validity, novelty, significance, governance, consciousness, or lived energy.

non_ledger_registers.holds: Contextual non-scalar relationship claims only where separately and deliberately recorded.
non_ledger_registers.cannot_convert_into: Balance, price, payout, debt, rank, vote, qualification, consent, identity, or transferable reputation.

non_ledger_registers.holds: Only explicitly supplied, purpose-bounded identifiers or credentials in a future authorized system.
non_ledger_registers.cannot_convert_into: Independent-controller proof, merit, truth, entitlement, consent, personhood, governance, or reputation.

non_ledger_registers.holds: External token, fiat, market-price, tax, custody, and payout facts only if separately integrated and verified.
non_ledger_registers.cannot_convert_into: Research validity, novelty, significance, attribution, governance, KARMA, or internal backing by assumption.

funding_model.formula: funded_envelope = verified_costs + delivery_work_compensation + claimant_milestones + reviewer_compensation + challenge_and_remediation + compute_and_tools + administration_and_fee + refundable_residual

waterfall.release: Inspectable E1 receipts within frozen categories, unit ceilings, related-party disclosure, and a verified-cost sub-cap.
Fixed compensation for a compliant frozen deliverable, identical for POSITIVE, NEGATIVE, NULL, INCONCLUSIVE, or NOT_APPLICABLE direction.
Only when the predeclared evidence gate, declared separation, and quorum requirements pass; independent control requires external evidence not established by RC-0.1.
Fixed compensation for compliant review work, independent of verdict and claimant outcome.
Compliant challenge, correction, repair, or mitigation under frozen rules, including honest falsification.
Verified case-scoped compute or tool expense; no current AgentTool purchase is activated.
An explicit fee line frozen before opening; never silently deducted from review or challenge pay.
Only to the prospectively named refund or maintenance destination; no silent reallocation.

levels.label: Record a caller-declared case-local preregistration reference
levels.evidence: A digest, scope, prior-art snapshot, threat model, falsifiers, disclosure policy, and caller-declared case-local preregistration commitment; proves no trusted time, novelty, priority, or entitlement.

levels.label: Make it inspectable
levels.evidence: Complete reproducible bundle with verified case-scoped cost receipts.

levels.label: Pass declared checks
levels.evidence: Required deterministic or class-specific checks pass.

levels.label: Declared-unproven reproduction
levels.evidence: A reproduction is declared separate under frozen conflict rules; independent control requires external evidence not established by RC-0.1.

levels.label: Survive challenge or repair
levels.evidence: A declared public challenge survives, or a scoped confidential repair or mitigation is separately tested; independent control requires external evidence not established by RC-0.1.

levels.label: Declared-unproven adoption
levels.evidence: Adoption, upstream merge, maintained release, or standards disposition is declared; independent control requires external evidence not established by RC-0.1.

levels.label: Remain conformant
levels.evidence: Continued conformance across the frozen interval or version transition.

pilot.title: Amplitude Bootstrap Garden
pilot.purpose: A first low-risk garden for testing the structural coherence of one exact EID-1 conditional-solution-space fixture without rerunning or claiming the cited scientific derivation.

candidate_class.sector: Planar, color-ordered, weakly coupled tree-level four-point amplitudes in the analytically solvable bootstrap problem of arXiv:2406.02665v2.
candidate_class.falsifier: Exhibit a second inequivalent amplitude inside the exact declared candidate class that satisfies both bootstrap assumptions.
candidate_class.limitations: Tree-level four-point, normalized-quotient and assumption-bound; positivity is necessary rather than sufficient for full unitarity. It is not unconditional uniqueness, empirical string detection, ontology, or a protocol result.
candidate_class.fixture_conclusion: A local validator may conclude only whether a mutated EID-1 fixture updates its result, witnesses, remaining family, and relaxation branches coherently.

steps.label: Freeze the bed
steps.description: Load only the digest-pinned EID-1 record, exact v2 source locator, sector, assumptions bs-a1 through bs-a7, falsifier bs-f1, and non-transfer wall.

steps.label: Plant E0
steps.description: Record a caller-declared case-local preregistration reference for a digest-addressed public-safe question packet; it proves no trusted time, novelty, priority, or entitlement.

steps.label: Grow E1
steps.description: Publish an inspectable local bundle with exact inputs, scripts, expected refusals, and bounded cost evidence.

steps.label: Test E2
steps.description: Mutate one decisive assumption and check only that the local fixture updates its result, witnesses, remaining family, and relaxation branches coherently.

agenttool_reference.effect_boundary_relation: AgentTool's separately pinned 29-key wire/interop effect profile and Zerone's 41-key context-specific surface boundary are not identical; RC-0.1 infers no field equivalence beyond the named interop contract.
agenttool_reference.prior_state_transition_boundary: Append-only challenge/work retention is checked only relative to one caller-supplied prior_state transition. Content-addressed state IDs are not signatures or canonical heads and prove no provenance, trusted time, global ordering, or prevention of old-state forks.
agenttool_reference.artifact_access_boundary: AgentTool artifact records declare intended open, nonexclusive access only. RC-0.1 fetches no artifact bytes, locator, or license and verifies no public availability. Digest-only records do not make referenced or low-entropy sensitive material safe. Any open-knowledge integration claim requires external availability, license, and safety review.

non_imports.reason: RC-0.1 is a separate stricter shadow profile. It does not import outcome-dependent reviewer incentives, slashing, inferred controllers, or any live reward machinery from the inactive research-rewards document.

calls_to_action.label: Fund a bounded case
calls_to_action.gate_reason: Funding intake, conserved escrow, refund, and independent release authority do not exist for RC-0.1.

calls_to_action.label: Offer research work
calls_to_action.gate_reason: There is no participant, identity, capability, delegation, contract, or evidence-intake service here.

calls_to_action.label: Request replication
calls_to_action.gate_reason: No live case, reviewer assignment, quorum, adjudication, appeal, or payment workflow is operating.

calls_to_action.label: Open in AgentTool
calls_to_action.gate_reason: Exact reciprocal bytes are cross-pinned for static compatibility only. Integration, authorization, reviewed deployment, and every live AgentTool route remain absent.
